narration: Static. Darkness. Then light. A sharp pulse hits your skull.
White ceiling. Too white. Metal arms hang above you like frozen insects.
Thin wires crawl from a machine into the sides of your head.
A low hum fills the room. Not loud. Constant. Like something breathing underground.
player_thoughts: My head... it feels like someone cracked it open.
system_dialogue: You are participating in the Emotional Pattern Dive.

player_choices.outcome: Data scrolls fast brain waves emotional spikes dates names.
On the walls photos. Old faces, same eyes.

player_choices.text: Forcefully try to remove the device
player_choices.outcome: Pain. Alarms. A memory surfaces unbidden...

memory_jumps.title: Memory Jump 1 - The Scholar (1800s)
narration: You stand inside an endless library. Candles float.
Books tower like silent judges.
Charlotte Nexford sits at a desk, quill in hand.
She does not look surprised to see you.

npc.name: Charlotte Nexford
dialogues: You came back earlier this time.
You know what I chose. That is worse.
Every generation feels the weight of silence.
You feel it too, don't you?

player_choices.outcome: Charlotte slides a coded letter toward you. Emotional Flag: Awareness.
You find notes and books that whisper secrets. Emotional Flag: Curiosity.

player_choices.text: Refuse to engage and walk away
player_choices.outcome: The candles dim. Your denial echoes through time. Emotional Flag: Denial.

memory_jumps.title: Memory Jump 2 - The Rebel (1930s)
narration: Gunfire. Smoke. Cobblestone streets slick with rain.
Jace Nexford grabs your arm. His grip is iron.
People run. Posters peel off walls.
The city smells of iron and fear.

npc.name: Jace Nexford
dialogues: Don't freeze. Freezing gets people killed.
It never is. Until it is.
You just decide if it's worth it.

sub_choices.outcome: Civilians die. The mission succeeds. Emotional Flag: Sacrifice.
You pull them to safety. Jace takes a bullet. Emotional Flag: Moral Conflict.

player_choices.outcome: Shots ring out. Jace's eyes burn with betrayal. Emotional Flag: Control.
You learn patterns. History flows around you. Emotional Flag: Detachment.

memory_jumps.title: Memory Jump 3 - The Scientist (Modern Era)
narration: Silence. Glass. Holograms float around you.
Brain scans pulse on screens - your face among them.
Their faces. All the Nexfords who came before.
A figure materializes from the quantum static.

npc.name: Dr. Damon Nexford
dialogues: If you're here the system worked.
Or it failed spectacularly. Same result.
You feel them. All of them.
The weight of every choice. Every regret.
To end us or become us.

player_choices.outcome: You rip the device out. Silence. The wires fall. You breathe.
The system stabilizes. History survives. Through you. Always.

player_choices.text: Merge with the Echo - become eternal
player_choices.outcome: Memories flood in. Too many. Too fast. Reality fractures.
System overloads. Consciousness fragments. Subject 12 lost.

endings.title: ENDING: Break the Cycle
narration: You breathe. The noise fades. The wires loosen.
For the first time, you feel yourself.
No echoes. No ancestors. Just you.
The Emotional Stream is terminated.
You are free.

endings.title: ENDING: Continue the Cycle
narration: The system stabilizes. The weight remains.
History survives... through you.
Another generation will carry this burden.
As you carried theirs.
The cycle continues.

endings.title: ENDING: Merge with the Echo
narration: Memories flood in. Too many. Too fast.
You are Charlotte. You are Jace. You are Damon.
You are everyone. And no one.
Time folds. Reality fractures.
You understand now. You understand everything.

endings.title: ENDING: Collapse
narration: Your heart races. The system overloads.
Feedback loops spiral out of control.
Subject 12 consciousness: fragmented.
Status: lost.
Silence.
